identity: A one-handed sword for a young adventurer, the player's first weapon: a straight blade about three times as long as the grip, a simple round crossguard with one small accent gem in its centre, a wrapped grip and a round pommel. The blade's cutting edge and tip read clearly. No sheath, no hand, no extra swords.

A small round fox-like pet creature that follows the player: big head, large upright ears, short legs, a bushy tail held out to the side so it is fully visible, big friendly eyes. Standing calmly on all four paws, all four paws visible, nothing in its mouth, no collar, no accessories.
